user_query: I'm attending a conference in San Francisco and I need to find a hotel near the event venue. Can you help me search for nearby hotels and also provide the head-to-head stats and previous encounters of the home and away team in the upcoming football match? And, give me a list of fixture IDs.

TaskList.description: Search for hotels near the conference venue in San Francisco.
Retrieve head-to-head statistics of the home and away football teams.
Get previous encounters of the home and away football teams.
Fetch a list of fixture IDs related to the upcoming match.
